quests.prompt: A student is planning an essay about public parks. Which sentence is a claim?

frameworkPillars.label: Claim Statement
frameworkPillars.role: Takes a definitive stance on the topic.
frameworkPillars.example: Schools should integrate practical life skills into the mandatory curriculum.

frameworkPillars.label: Logical Justification
frameworkPillars.role: Provides the underlying reason why the claim is sound.
frameworkPillars.example: Young adults face complex financial and civic obligations immediately upon graduation.

frameworkPillars.label: Signpost Transition
frameworkPillars.role: Concession
frameworkPillars.guidance: Grants partial merit to the counter-argument to appear balanced.

frameworkPillars.label: Conclusive Synthesis
frameworkPillars.role: Conclusion / Synthesis
frameworkPillars.guidance: Brings all arguments together into a decisive final judgement.

quests.modelArgument: In my view, schools should mandate financial literacy because teenagers need budgeting skills before entering college. Ultimately, early preparation prevents debt and empowers independent decisions.
quests.teachingTip: A persuasive opinion is never a bare preference. Pair your stance with a causal connector ("because", "since") and anchor the conclusion with a synthesis signpost.
quests.explanation: Effective argumentation relies on transparent signposts that tell the listener exactly how your reasons connect to your core position.
